paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how accuracy varies with different values of initial confidence for three plotted series with error bars. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0.91 to 0.98 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.01 intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. A blue solid line with circular markers stays near the top of the chart across the x-range, rising from about 0.85 at 0.91 to 1.00 at 0.92, then remaining around 0.97–1.00 through 0.98 (approximately 0.98 at 0.93, 0.97 at 0.94, 0.99 at 0.95, 1.00 at 0.96, 0.99 at 0.97, and 1.00 at 0.98). An orange dashed line with diamond markers increases early and then declines steadily, starting near 0.65 at 0.91, reaching about 0.92 at 0.92, then dropping across subsequent points to roughly 0.81 (0.93), 0.74 (0.94), 0.56 (0.95), 0.35 (0.96), 0.21 (0.97), and about 0.08 at 0.98. A green dash-dot line with square markers starts low, dips, and then increases, beginning around 0.21 at 0.91, falling to about 0.07 at 0.92, then rising to approximately 0.16 (0.93), 0.23 (0.94), 0.42 (0.95), 0.65 (0.96), 0.78 (0.97), and about 0.91 at 0.98; all three series include vertical error bars at each x-value.
